CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.batch_spec_workspace_execution_last_dequeue()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO batch_spec_workspace_execution_last_dequeues (user_id, latest_dequeue)
    VALUES (NEW.user_id, COALESCE(NEW.started_at, now()))

        batch_spec_workspace_execution_last_dequeues.latest_dequeue, EXCLUDED.latest_dequeue);
    RETURN NULL;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.changeset_computed_state(p_state text, p_num_failures integer, p_publication_state text, p_external_state text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
    SELECT CASE
        WHEN p_state = 'errored' OR (p_state = 'queued' AND p_num_failures > 0) THEN 'RETRYING'
        WHEN p_state IN ('failed', 'canceled') THEN 'FAILED'
        WHEN p_state = 'scheduled' THEN 'SCHEDULED'
        WHEN p_state <> 'completed' THEN 'PROCESSING'
        WHEN p_publication_state = 'UNPUBLISHED' THEN 'UNPUBLISHED'
        ELSE COALESCE(p_external_state, 'OPEN')
    END
$function$

exhaustive_search_job_state(job bigint).definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.exhaustive_search_job_state(job bigint)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
    WITH states AS (
        SELECT state FROM exhaustive_search_jobs WHERE id = job
        UNION ALL
        SELECT state FROM exhaustive_search_repo_jobs WHERE search_job_id = job
        UNION ALL
        SELECT rr.state
        FROM exhaustive_search_repo_revision_jobs rr
        JOIN exhaustive_search_repo_jobs r ON r.id = rr.search_repo_job_id
        WHERE r.search_job_id = job
    ), counts AS (
        SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'canceled')   AS canceled,
               count(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'processing') AS processing,
               count(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'errored')    AS errored,
               count(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'queued')     AS queued,
               count(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'failed')     AS failed,
               count(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'completed')  AS completed
        FROM states
    )
    SELECT CASE
        WHEN canceled > 0 THEN 'canceled'
        WHEN processing > 0 OR errored > 0 THEN 'processing'
        WHEN queued > 0 AND completed = 0 THEN 'queued'
        WHEN queued > 0 THEN 'processing'
        WHEN failed > 0 THEN 'failed'
        WHEN completed > 0 THEN 'completed'
        ELSE 'queued'
    END
    FROM counts
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.repo_restricted(p_repo_id integer, p_private boolean, p_user_mapping boolean)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
    SELECT p_private
       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM repo_permissions rp WHERE rp.repo_id = p_repo_id AND rp.unrestricted)
       AND (p_user_mapping OR NOT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM external_service_repos esr
               JOIN external_services es ON es.id = esr.external_service_id
               WHERE esr.repo_id = p_repo_id AND es.unrestricted AND es.deleted_at IS NULL))
$function$
